abstract: Intensive chemotherapy with bleomycin and vinblastine was used as initial treatment in patients with advanced testicular teratoma and after relapse following lymph-node irradiation in patients with early-stage disease. Between January, 1976, and March, 1978, 84 patients, 28 with early disease and 56 with advanced disease, were treated. All 28 men with early-stage disease are alive and disease-free. Patients with advanced disease were divided into two groups. Patients with bulky multiple lung metastases and those with liver involvement did poorly, only 4 of 23 (17.4%) being disease-free. Conversely, patients with bulky abdominal nodes and those with limited lung disease did well, 17 of 21 previously untreated patients (80.9%) being alive and disease-free. Within the latter group, 16 patients were managed with chemotherapy and radiotherapy and/or surgery. Of these, 15 (93.4%) are disease-free.
abstract_ja: 進行精巣奇形腫の患者には初回治療として強力なブレオマイシン・ビンブラスチン化学療法を、リンパ節照射後に再発した初期病変の患者には化学療法を用いた。1976年1月から1978年3月の間に84例（初期病変28例、進行病変56例）を治療した。初期病変の男性28例は全員生存し無病である。進行病変の患者は2群に分けた。大きな多発肺転移や肝浸潤のある患者は予後不良で、23例中4例（17.4%）のみが無病であった。一方、大きな腹部リンパ節腫大や限局性肺病変の患者は良好で、未治療の21例中17例（80.9%）が生存し無病であった。後者の群のうち16例は化学療法と放射線療法および/または手術で治療され、このうち15例（93.4%）が無病である。
